description: QuaDRiGa is provided by Fraunhofer HHI. QuaDRiGa generates radio-channel impulse responses using three-dimensional geometry-based stochastic modelling. Fraunhofer HHI documents multi-antenna, indoor, satellite and heterogeneous-network scenarios and calibration against 3GPP channel models. Geographic context: global.
